incident-bot: PagerDuty alert — HIGH severity
pagerduty-bot: Service: embeddings-service
pagerduty-bot: Symptom: request queue depth > 75% and 504 response surge (rolling 5m)
pagerduty-bot: Triggered at 2024-11-15 12:07:01 UTC
pagerduty-bot: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-queue
pagerduty-bot: Affected: production region us-east-1; approx 2% of traffic currently failing

Alice W: I'm taking this. Acknowledging on PD now. Starting with metrics and logs.
Alice W: @Kevin L do you know if there was a recent config change to prefetch/batching?

Kevin L: There was a deploy ~5m ago that touched embedding worker batching params (commit abc123). Deploy looks green from CI: `deploy-bot: deploy succeeded commit abc123 -> prod (12:02 UTC)`

Marta R: If queue depth is high and pods are OOMing, scaling might help short-term. Also check KV cache miss rate. Runbook step 2: bump replicas by 2 and watch.

Alice W: Doing quick scale: `kubectl scale deployment embeddings-worker --replicas=6 -n prod`
Alice W: Restarting one pod to pick up env change: `kubectl rollout restart deploy/embeddings-worker -n prod`

deploy-bot: Restart triggered for deployment embeddings-worker — started 3 pods

Alice W: Logs from pod embeddings-worker-2:
```
2024-11-15T12:05:58Z ERROR backpressure: queue_depth=812/1024
2024-11-15T12:06:02Z ERROR runtime: OOMKilled while allocating tensor 512MB
2024-11-15T12:06:03Z WARN cache: miss_rate=0.92
```

Devon P: Customer impact: Support ticket #5467 — customer sees 504s on batch embeddings (2 customers reporting); internal 504 rate peaked 18% on the last 5m window.

Alice W: Scaling seems to help — tokenization latency dropped and 504s falling. Current metrics snapshot: latency p50 120ms -> 78ms, 504 rate 18% -> 4% after scale.
Alice W: Also rolled back the dynamic_prefetch feature flag on embeddings-service (flipped ff/feature/dynamic_prefetch -> off) as a precaution.

Kevin L: Good catch on dynamic_prefetch — that matches the commit. We should revert the batching-default change in the commit if this persists.

Marta R: I'll keep an eye on memory and KV cache after scaling. If pods still OOM, we need to adjust batch-size or enable per-request CPU limits. Adding temporary autoscale policy for queue pressure.

incident-bot: PagerDuty acknowledgement recorded: acknowledged by Alice W at 2024-11-15 12:10:04 UTC

Alice W: Handing off monitoring/hardening to Marta for follow-up and postmortem. I'll put notes in the incident doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/embeddings-2024-11-15
Alice W: Final immediate mitigation: scaled replicas to 6, rolled back dynamic_prefetch FF, restarted pods.

Marta R: Taking ownership for follow-up. Action items:
- Reproduce memory spike locally with dynamic_prefetch on
- Add KV cache hit-rate alert and adjust threshold to 80%
- Consider lowering default batch_size for embeddings by 10%
- Postmortem draft by EOD tomorrow

Devon P: Communicated to affected customers via status page + outbound messages. Will keep support channel updated.

Alice W: Leaving the incident thread. Will ping if anything regresses. :white_check_mark:

Marta R: Marking incident resolved for now — will update incident doc with timeline and RCA when complete.
